articles.title: Centre rushes 2 RAF companies to violence-hit Arunachal Pradesh - The Economic Times
articles.full_text:
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) directed on Saturday that the RAF companies comprising about 250 personnel will be airlifted from Navi Mumbai on board an IAF transport aircraft. The units will reach Pasighat and get deployed by Sunday, the officials told PTI.

RAF is a special blue-uniform donning anti-riot unit of the CRPF.
Multiple units of the CRPF are already deployed in the violence-affected areas. Arunachal Pradesh has a permanent deployment of about 2-3 CRPF battalions.
